en.s: The siege or battle of Pavia was fought in 773–774 in northern Italy, near Ticinum (modern Pavia), and resulted in the victory of the Franks under Charlemagne against the Lombards under King Desiderius.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 帕维亚围城战（或称帕维亚战役）于773年至774年在意大利北部、提基努姆（今帕维亚）附近爆发。查理曼率领的法兰克人击败了德西德里乌斯国王率领的伦巴第人。

en.t: Theodora is crowned Byzantine empress and marries Theophilos
en.s: Theodora was crowned Byzantine empress at the Church of St Stephen in Constantinople on June 5, 830, and married Emperor Theophilos on the same day. She later served as regent for their young son Michael III after Theophilos died in 842. The restoration of the veneration of icons for which she is remembered took place during that later regency, not at the wedding.
en.n: June 5 was Theodora's coronation and marriage in Constantinople; the precise church of the wedding is disputed. Her restoration of icons came later, in 843.

zh.t: 狄奥多拉加冕为拜占庭皇后，并与狄奥斐卢斯成婚
zh.s: 830年6月5日，狄奥多拉在君士坦丁堡的圣斯蒂芬教堂加冕为拜占庭皇后，同一天与皇帝狄奥斐卢斯成婚。狄奥斐卢斯于842年去世后，她为年幼的儿子米海尔三世摄政。她后来推动恢复圣像崇敬，这件事发生在摄政期间，并非婚礼当天。
zh.n: 6月5日是狄奥多拉在君士坦丁堡加冕和成婚的日期；婚礼具体在哪座教堂举行仍有争议。恢复圣像崇敬则是在843年。

en.s: The Battle of Ménfő was an important battle in the early history of the Kingdom of Hungary. Fought in 1044 at Ménfő, near Győr, between an army of mostly Germans and Hungarians (Magyars), it was a victory for the Germans and thus for Westernising influences in Hungary. Peter Orseolo, who had been deposed by Samuel Aba in 1041, returned with the assistance of Emperor Henry III, and invaded Hungary in June 1044.

zh.s: 门福之战是匈牙利王国早期历史上的一场重要战役。1044年，以德意志人和匈牙利人为主的两支军队在杰尔附近的门福交战，德意志一方获胜，亲西方势力因而在匈牙利增强。彼得·奥尔塞奥洛于1041年被绍穆埃尔·奥鲍废黜，1044年6月在皇帝亨利三世协助下返回并进攻匈牙利。

en.s: The battle of Ain Salm was a battle between the forces of Tutush, the Seljuk ruler of Syria and brother of the Seljuk sultan Malik Shah, and Suleiman ibn Qutalmish, the Seljuk ruler of Anatolia in June 1086 close to the city of Aleppo.

zh.s: 1086年6月，塞尔柱叙利亚统治者、苏丹马立克沙阿的弟弟图图什，与塞尔柱安纳托利亚统治者苏莱曼·伊本·库特卢米什的军队在阿勒颇附近交战，史称艾因萨尔姆之战。

en.t: Battle of the Gulf of Naples
en.s: The naval Battle of the Gulf of Naples took place on 5 June 1284 in the south of the Gulf of Naples, Italy, when an Aragonese-Sicilian galley fleet commanded by Roger of Lauria defeated a Neapolitan galley fleet commanded by Charles of Salerno (later Charles II of Naples) and captured Charles. Charles' Genoese allies had collected several large fleets of galleys, and Lauria determined to attack Charles' galleys which were at Naples before these could join them and hunt down Lauria. He used the cover of darkness to arrive off Naples, where he made several raids ashore to try to tempt Charles out where he could be fought.

zh.s: 1284年6月5日，意大利那不勒斯湾南部发生海战。罗杰·德·劳里亚率领的阿拉贡—西西里桨帆船舰队击败萨莱诺的查理（后来的那不勒斯国王查理二世）率领的那不勒斯舰队，并俘获查理。查理的热那亚盟友集结了多支大型桨帆船舰队。劳里亚决定先攻击停泊在那不勒斯的查理舰队，避免它们与盟军会合后追击自己。他借夜色驶抵那不勒斯，在岸边多次袭扰，试图引诱查理出战。

en.s: The Battle of Worringen was fought on 5 June 1288 near the town of Worringen (also spelled Woeringen), which is now part of Chorweiler, the northernmost borough (Stadtbezirk) of Cologne. It was the decisive battle of the War of the Limburg Succession, fought for the possession of the Duchy of Limburg between on one side the Archbishop Siegfried II of Cologne and Count Henry VI of Luxembourg, and on the other side, Duke John I of Brabant.

zh.s: 沃林根战役于1288年6月5日在沃林根镇附近爆发，该地现属科隆最北端的城区乔尔韦勒。战役是林堡继承战争的决定性战斗，双方争夺林堡公国：一方是科隆大主教齐格弗里德二世和卢森堡伯爵亨利六世，另一方是布拉班特公爵约翰一世。

en.s: The Battle of Fontaine-Française occurred on 5 June 1595 between the French royal forces of King Henry IV of France and troops of Spain and the Catholic League commanded by Juan Fernández de Velasco and Charles of Lorraine, Duke of Mayenne during the eighth and final war (1585-1598) of the French Wars of Religion.

zh.s: 1595年6月5日，法国国王亨利四世的王室军队与西班牙军队及天主教联盟军队交战。西班牙军队和天主教联盟军队由胡安·费尔南德斯·德贝拉斯科和梅耶讷公爵夏尔·德洛林率领。这场战役发生在法国宗教战争的第八次、也是最后一次战争（1585—1598年）期间。

en.s: Tethys' Festival was a masque produced on 5 June 1610 to celebrate the investiture of Prince Henry (1594–1612) as Prince of Wales. Prince Henry, the son of James VI and I and Anne of Denmark, was made Prince of Wales in June 1610. Among the formalities and festivities of the occasion, the masque Tethys' Festival was performed by courtiers at Whitehall Palace.

zh.s: 《忒提斯庆典》是一场假面剧，于1610年6月5日上演，庆祝亨利王子（1594—1612年）受封威尔士亲王。亨利是詹姆斯六世及一世与丹麦的安妮之子，同年6月受封。庆典仪式和活动期间，宫廷人士在怀特霍尔宫演出了这场假面剧。

en.s: On June 5, 1615, the Eastern Army of Tokugawa Ieyasu and the Osaka Army of Toyotomi Hideyori clashed in battle at Dōmyōji (道明寺の戦い; Dōmyōji no tatakai), Osaka. This battle was one of Japan's major historical battles between samurai forces. This battle was one of a number of battles that took place during the Summer Campaign of the Siege of Osaka that led up to the fall of Osaka to the forces of Tokugawa and the death of Toyotomi Hideyori.

zh.s: 1615年6月5日，德川家康的东军与丰臣秀赖的大坂军在大坂道明寺交战。这是日本历史上武士军队之间的重要战役之一，也是大坂夏之阵期间发生的一系列战斗之一。此后德川军攻陷大坂，丰臣秀赖身亡。

en.s: The Battle of Benburb took place on 5 June 1646 during the Irish Confederate Wars, the Irish theatre of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It was fought between the forces of Confederate Ireland under Owen Roe O'Neill and a Scottish Covenanter and Anglo-Irish army under Robert Monro. The battle ended in a decisive victory for the Irish Confederates and ended the Scottish hopes of conquering Ireland and imposing their own religious settlement there.

zh.s: 本伯布战役于1646年6月5日爆发，属于爱尔兰邦联战争，也是三王国战争在爱尔兰的战事之一。交战双方是欧文·罗·奥尼尔率领的爱尔兰邦联军，以及罗伯特·蒙罗率领的苏格兰盟约派和英爱联军。爱尔兰邦联军取得决定性胜利，苏格兰征服爱尔兰并在当地推行自身宗教制度的希望也随之破灭。

en.s: The Battle of Y Dalar Hir took place on 5 June 1648 in Caernarfonshire, North Wales, during the Second English Civil War. While little more than a skirmish, it had a significant effect on the local progress of the conflict. Leading Welsh Royalist Sir John Owen of Clenennau mustered a group of 250-300 cavalry and foot in an attempt to raise North Wales in rebellion against Parliament; on 3 June he defeated local militia in a skirmish near Caernarfon and besieged Caernarfon Castle.

zh.s: Y Dalar Hir战役于1648年6月5日在北威尔士卡那封郡爆发，属于第二次英国内战。这场战斗规模不大，更像一次小规模冲突，但对当地战局影响显著。威尔士保王党领袖、克莱嫩瑙的约翰·欧文爵士集结了250至300名骑兵和步兵，试图发动北威尔士反议会起义；6月3日，他在卡那封附近击败当地民兵，并围攻卡那封城堡。

en.s: The Battle of Colorno consisted of two battles, fought between 25 May and 5 June 1734, between Franco-Sardinian and Austrian (Habsburg) troops as part of the War of Polish Succession. Begun on 25 May 1734, the Imperial Austro-German armies conquered and occupied Colorno and its palace during the decisive attack of 1 June. During the second battle of 4-5 June the Franco-Piedmontese drove them out of Colorno again, forcing them to withdraw.

zh.s: 科洛尔诺战役包括两场战斗，发生于1734年5月25日至6月5日，是波兰王位继承战争的一部分，交战双方为法—撒丁联军与奥地利（哈布斯堡）军队。5月25日，奥地利帝国和德意志军队发起战斗，并在6月1日的决定性进攻中攻占科洛尔诺及其宫殿。6月4日至5日的第二场战斗中，法—皮埃蒙特联军将他们赶出科洛尔诺，迫使其撤退。

en.t: British forces capture Port-Républicain during the Haitian Revolution
en.s: British troops entered Port-Républicain, now Port-au-Prince in Haiti, on June 5, 1794, after French Republican defenders lost Fort Joseph. The seizure ended a several-day British attack on the city during the Haitian Revolution. The town was part of the French colony of Saint-Domingue at the time.
en.n: June 5 was the fall of Fort Joseph and British entry into the city, rather than the start of the attack on May 30.

zh.t: 英军占领圣多明各殖民地的太子港
zh.s: 1794年6月5日，英军攻下约瑟夫堡后进入共和港，即今天海地的太子港，结束了持续数日的攻城战。当时海地革命正在进行，这座城市仍属法国殖民地圣多明各。
zh.n: 6月5日是约瑟夫堡失守、英军入城的日期；攻城战始于5月30日。

en.s: The Battle of New Ross was a military engagement which took place in New Ross, County Wexford during the Irish Rebellion of 1798. It was fought between the Society of United Irishmen rebels and government forces garrisoning the town. The attack on the town of New Ross on the River Barrow, was an attempt by the recently victorious rebels to break out of county Wexford across the river Barrow and to spread the rebellion into county Kilkenny and the nearby province of Munster.

zh.s: 1798年6月5日，联合爱尔兰人会的起义军进攻爱尔兰韦克斯福德郡的新罗斯，试图渡过巴罗河，把起义扩展到基尔肯尼郡和芒斯特省。驻城政府军最终击退了进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Iller River or Battle of Erolzheim (5 June 1800) saw a French Republican army led by Jean Victor Marie Moreau fight a Habsburg Austrian army led by Paul Kray. In late May, the adversaries reached a stalemate with the Austrian army holding Ulm and the French army facing it from the south. Both armies numbered about 80,000 men.

zh.s: 伊勒河战役又称埃罗尔茨海姆战役，于1800年6月5日爆发。让-维克托·马里·莫罗率领的法兰西共和军与保罗·克雷率领的哈布斯堡奥地利军队交战。5月下旬，双方陷入僵局：奥军控制乌尔姆，法军则在其南面部署。两军各约有8万人。

en.s: The Invasion of Hanover in 1803 during the Napoleonic Wars saw a French army under Édouard Mortier invade and occupy the Electorate of Hanover in Northern Germany following the breakdown of the Peace of Amiens. Hanover was under the rule of George III in a personal union with Britain, the principal enemy of Napoleon's French Empire. One consequence of the invasion was the formation of the exiled King's German Legion in British service.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1803年，拿破仑战争期间，埃杜瓦·莫蒂埃率领法军入侵并占领德国北部的汉诺威选侯国。此前《亚眠和约》破裂。汉诺威由乔治三世统治，与英国处于共主邦联关系；英国是拿破仑法兰西帝国的主要敌人。入侵的一个后果是，流亡的国王德意志军团在英国服役。

en.s: The June 1809 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on June 5, 1809, in order to elect the governor of Maryland following the resignation of Democratic-Republican governor Robert Wright on May 6, 1809. Democratic-Republican nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 7th district Edward Lloyd was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against Federalist candidates former United States Senator Charles Carroll and Benjamin Stoddart.

zh.s: 马里兰州于1809年6月5日举行州长选举，接替5月6日辞职的民主共和党州长罗伯特·赖特。民主共和党候选人、曾任马里兰州第7选区美国众议员的爱德华·劳埃德，在州议会投票中击败联邦党候选人、前美国参议员查尔斯·卡罗尔和本杰明·斯托达特，当选州长。

en.s: The June Rebellion, also called the Paris Uprising of 1832 (French: Insurrection républicaine à Paris en juin 1832), was an anti-monarchist insurrection of Parisian republicans on 5 and 6 June 1832. The rebellion originated in an attempt by republicans to reverse the establishment in 1830 of the July Monarchy of Louis Philippe, shortly after the deaths from cholera of Prime Minister Casimir Pierre Périer and General Jean Maximilien Lamarque, a former Army commander who became a member of the French parliament and was critical of the monarchy.

zh.s: 六月起义又称1832年巴黎起义，是巴黎共和派于1832年6月5日至6日发动的一场反君主制起义。起义者试图推翻1830年建立的路易-菲利普七月王朝。此前，总理卡西米尔·皮埃尔·佩里耶和前陆军指挥官、后成为法国议员并批评君主制的让·马克西米利安·拉马克相继死于霍乱。

en.s: The First Battle of Dybbøl was the first of three battles of the First War of Schleswig to be fought at the town of Dybbøl between the Danish army and forces of Prussia and the other German states.

zh.s: 第一次迪伯尔战役是第一次石勒苏益格战争期间，丹麦军队与普鲁士及其他德意志邦国军队在迪伯尔进行的三场战斗中的首场。

en.s: The 1857 Yatala colonial by-election was held on 5 June 1857 to elect one of two members for Yatala in the South Australian House of Assembly, after sitting member Charles Simeon Hare resigned on 12 May 1857. Richard Bullock Andrews won the by-election with 51 per cent of the vote.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚众议院亚塔拉选区于1857年6月5日举行殖民地补选，选出两名议员中的一人。补选因在任议员查尔斯·西缅·黑尔于1857年5月12日辞职而举行。理查德·布洛克·安德鲁斯以51%的选票赢得补选。

en.s: The Battle of Pig Point, Virginia was an engagement between the Union gunboat USRC Harriet Lane and a shore battery and rifle company of the Confederate Army on June 5, 1861 in the third month of the American Civil War. Pig Point is located in Portsmouth, Virginia at the mouth of the Nansemond River near Hampton Roads, Virginia. This location is about 5 miles (8.0 km) from Newport News, Virginia. The engagement occurred before any significant battles, other than the opening Battle of Fort Sumter, had taken place and received some notoriety at the time.

zh.s: 美国内战第三个月，即1861年6月5日，弗吉尼亚州猪角发生战斗。联邦海关缉私船“哈丽雅特·莱恩”号与邦联军岸炮阵地及步枪连交战。猪角位于弗吉尼亚州朴次茅斯的南蒙德河河口附近，靠近汉普顿锚地，距纽波特纽斯约5英里（8公里）。除了内战初期的萨姆特堡战役外，此前尚未发生过重大交战，因此这场战斗当时受到一定关注。

en.s: The Battle of Tranter's Creek was fought on June 5, 1862, in Pitt County, North Carolina, as part of Union Maj. Gen. Ambrose E. Burnside's North Carolina expedition during the American Civil War. On June 5, Col. Robert Potter, garrison commander at Washington, North Carolina, ordered a reconnaissance in the direction of Pactolus. The 24th Massachusetts, under Lt. Col. F. A. Osborne, advanced to the bridge over Tranter's Creek, where it encountered the 44th North Carolina, under Col. George Singletary. Unable to force a crossing, Osborne fired his artillery (Companies A–G, 1st New York Marine Artillery) at the mill buildings in which the Confederates were barricaded.

zh.s: 1862年6月5日，美国内战期间，安布罗斯·E·伯恩赛德少将率领的联邦军北卡罗来纳远征队在北卡罗来纳州皮特县发动特兰特溪战役。6月5日，华盛顿镇守军指挥官罗伯特·波特上校下令向帕克托勒斯方向侦察。F·A·奥斯本中校率领的马萨诸塞第24团推进至特兰特溪桥，遭遇乔治·辛格尔特里上校率领的北卡罗来纳第44团。奥斯本无法强行渡河，于是命令炮兵向邦联军设防的磨坊建筑开火；炮兵由纽约海军陆战炮兵第1团A至G连组成。

en.s: The Treaty of Saigon (French: Traité de Saïgon, Vietnamese: Hòa ước Nhâm Tuất, referring to the year of "Water Dog" in the sexagenary cycle) was signed on 5 June 1862 between representatives of the colonial powers, France and Spain, and the last precolonial emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty, Emperor Tự Đức after the coalition's invasion during the Cochinchina campaign.

zh.s: 《西贡条约》（法语：Traité de Saïgon；越南语：Hòa ước Nhâm Tuất，意为六十甲子中的“壬戌年”）于1862年6月5日签署。签署方是殖民势力法国和西班牙的代表，以及阮朝末代皇帝嗣德帝。此前，法西联军已发动交趾支那战役。

en.s: The Battle of Piedmont was fought June 5, 1864, in the village of Piedmont, Augusta County, Virginia. Union Maj. Gen. David Hunter engaged Confederates under Brig. Gen. William E. "Grumble" Jones north of Piedmont. After severe fighting, Jones was killed and the Confederates were routed. Hunter occupied Staunton on June 6 and soon began to advance on Lynchburg, destroying military stores and public property in his wake.

zh.s: 皮埃蒙特战役于1864年6月5日在弗吉尼亚州奥古斯塔县的皮埃蒙特村爆发。联邦少将戴维·亨特在皮埃蒙特北面与威廉·E·“咕噜”·琼斯准将率领的邦联军交战。经过激战，琼斯阵亡，邦联军溃败。亨特于6月6日占领斯汤顿，随后向林奇堡推进，沿途摧毁军事物资和公共财产。

en.t: 1864–65 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1864–65 United States House of Representatives elections were held between June 5, 1864, and November 7, 1865, to elect the 192 members and nine non-voting delegates of the House of Representatives. The National Union Party expanded their existing majority against the backdrop of the American Civil War.

zh.s: 美国众议院选举于1864年6月5日至1865年11月7日举行，选出众议院192名议员和9名无投票权代表。国家联盟党在美国内战背景下扩大了原有多数席位。

en.t: Sultan Barghash signs the Zanzibar slave-trade treaty and closes the public market
en.s: Sultan Barghash of Zanzibar ratified a treaty with Britain on June 5, 1873 that banned the maritime export of enslaved people from his African dominions and required the closure of public markets for imported enslaved people. By his order, the public slave market in Zanzibar was cleared and closed that afternoon. The treaty restricted the slave trade; it did not abolish slavery throughout the sultanate.
en.n: The treaty and the Zanzibar market closure occurred June 5, 1873; the agreement did not end all slavery in Zanzibar.

zh.t: 桑给巴尔苏丹签署限制奴隶贸易的条约，并关闭公开市场
zh.s: 1873年6月5日，桑给巴尔苏丹巴尔加什批准与英国签订的条约，禁止从其非洲领地经海路输出奴隶，并要求关闭买卖输入奴隶的公开市场。当天下午，桑给巴尔的公开奴隶市场依他的命令关闭。条约限制了奴隶贸易，但没有废除苏丹国境内的所有奴隶制度。
zh.n: 条约获批准、桑给巴尔公开奴隶市场关闭都发生在6月5日；条约并未在当天废除当地所有奴隶制度。

en.t: 1876–77 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1876–77 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between June 5, 1876, and March 13, 1877. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives before the first session of the 45th United States Congress convened on October 15, 1877. The size of the House increased to 293 seats with the addition of the new state of Colorado.

en.s: Ontario general election, 1879 was the fourth general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on June 5, 1879, to elect the 88 Members of the 4th Legislative Assembly ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Oliver Mowat, won a third term in government with a larger majority in the Legislature. The Ontario Conservative Party, led by William Ralph Meredith, continued to lose seats.

zh.s: 1879年安大略省大选是加拿大安大略省举行的第四次大选，于6月5日举行，选出第4届立法议会的88名议员。奥利弗·莫瓦特领导的安大略自由党赢得更大的多数席位，第三次组建政府。威廉·拉尔夫·梅雷迪思领导的安大略保守党则继续失去席位。

en.s: The Zungeni Mountain skirmish took place on 5 June 1879 between British and Zulu forces during the second invasion of Zululand, in what is now South Africa, in the later stages of the Anglo-Zulu War. British irregular horse commanded by Colonel Redvers Buller discovered a force of 300 Zulus at the settlement of eZulaneni near Zungeni Mountain. The horsemen charged towards and scattered the Zulus before burning the settlement.

zh.s: 宗格尼山遭遇战于1879年6月5日爆发，是英祖战争后期第二次入侵祖鲁兰期间英军与祖鲁军队的一次交战，地点在今天的南非境内。雷德弗斯·布勒上校指挥的英国非正规骑兵在宗格尼山附近的埃祖拉内尼聚落发现300名祖鲁人。骑兵冲锋驱散了祖鲁人，随后焚毁该聚落。

en.s: The 1882 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on June 5, 1882 to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. The election matched Republican Zenas Ferry Moody, Speaker of the Oregon House of Representatives, against Democrat Joseph Showalter Smith, former member of the United States House of Representatives.

en.s: The 1888 Río de la Plata earthquake occurred on 5 June measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale, and shook the upper Río de la Plata at 3:20 UTC-3. The epicentre was located 15 kilometres (9 mi) southwest of Colonia del Sacramento (Uruguay) and 42 kilometres (26 mi) east of Buenos Aires (Argentina), with a hypocentre at a depth of 30 kilometres (19 mi).

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1890 was the seventh general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on June 5, 1890, to elect the 91 Members of the 7th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Liberal Party, led by Oliver Mowat, won a sixth consecutive term in government, despite losing a small number of seats in the Legislature.

en.s: The Liberal Revolution of 1895 took place in Ecuador, and was a period of radical social and political upheaval. The Revolution started on June 5, 1895 and ultimately resulted in the overthrow of the conservative government, which had ruled Ecuador for several decades, by the Radical Liberals, led by Eloy Alfaro. After the revolution, the new government legalized divorce, allowed religious freedom, and weakened the authority of the Church, which lost the land it held. The Revolution is often seen as marking the birth of modern Ecuador, with a new power structure that favored the Liberal Party, and new infrastructure projects such as the construction of a railway line between Quito and Guayaquil.

zh.s: 1895年厄瓜多尔爆发自由主义革命，社会和政治发生剧烈变革。革命于1895年6月5日开始，最终由埃洛伊·阿尔法罗领导的激进自由派推翻了执政数十年的保守派政府。革命后，新政府使离婚合法化、允许宗教自由、削弱教会权力并没收教会土地。这场革命常被视为现代厄瓜多尔的开端：新的权力结构支持自由党，并推动修建基多至瓜亚基尔铁路等基础设施。

en.t: Second Boer War: British soldiers take Pretoria
en.s: The Second Boer War was a conflict fought between 1899 and 1902 between the British Empire and the Boer republics (the South African Republic and Orange Free State) over Britain's influence in Southern Africa. The Witwatersrand Gold Rush caused an influx of "foreigners" (Uitlanders), most of them British from the Cape Colony, to the South African Republic (SAR), an independent Boer Republic.

en.s: The Tuapeka by-election was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Tuapeka, a rural seat at the bottom of the South Island. The by-election was held on 5 June 1908, and was precipitated by the death of sitting Liberal MP James Bennet. The election was won by William Chapple who stood as an independent Liberal.

en.s: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية‎‎ Al-Thawra al-`Arabiyya; Turkish: Arap İsyanı) or Great Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية الكبرى‎‎) began on June 5, 1916 and was declared on June 8 by the Sherif Hussein bin Ali with the aim of securing independence from the ruling Ottoman Turks and creating a single unified Arab state spanning from Aleppo in Syria to Aden in Yemen. Though the Sherifian revolt has tended to be regarded as a revolt rooted in a secular Arab nationalist sentiment the Sherif did not present it in those terms; rather, he accused the Young Turks of violating the sacred tenets of Islam and called Arab Muslims to sacred rebellion against the ostensibly "impious" Ottoman government.
en.n: The initial attacks at Medina began on 5 June 1916; the public proclamation at Mecca followed on 10 June.

zh.s: 阿拉伯起义（阿拉伯语：الثورة العربية‎，Al-Thawra al-`Arabiyya；土耳其语：Arap İsyanı），又称大阿拉伯起义，于1916年6月5日开始，6月8日谢里夫·侯赛因·本·阿里正式宣布。起义旨在摆脱奥斯曼土耳其统治，实现独立，并建立一个从叙利亚阿勒颇延伸至也门亚丁的统一阿拉伯国家。人们通常将侯赛因领导的起义视为源于世俗阿拉伯民族主义，但侯赛因并未这样阐述起义；他指责青年土耳其党违反伊斯兰教义，并号召阿拉伯穆斯林发动宗教起义，反抗他所称的“不虔诚”奥斯曼政府。
zh.n: 麦地那的初次袭击于1916年6月5日开始；6月10日随后在麦加公开宣布起义。

en.s: From March 9 to June 5, 1920, voters of the Republican Party elected delegates to the 1920 Republican National Convention for the purpose of choosing the party's nominee for president in the 1920 election. The delegates were largely contested between Governor Hiram Johnson of California, a progressive who had been the running mate of Theodore Roosevelt eight years prior; General Leonard Wood, one of Roosevelt's closest friends; and Frank O. Lowden, the Governor of Illinois.

zh.s: 1920年3月9日至6月5日，美国共和党选民通过初选选出参加当年共和党全国代表大会的代表，由大会决定总统候选人。代表席位的主要竞争者是加州州长海勒姆·约翰逊、与西奥多·罗斯福关系密切的将军伦纳德·伍德，以及伊利诺伊州州长弗兰克·O·洛登。约翰逊是进步派人士，八年前曾与罗斯福搭档竞选。

en.s: From March 9 to June 5, 1920, voters of the Democratic Party elected delegates to the 1920 Democratic National Convention, for the purposing of choosing a nominee for president in the 1920 United States presidential election. The race for delegates was made under a cloud of uncertainty because the party's two leading names, President Woodrow Wilson and three-time nominee William Jennings Bryan, withheld their intentions; both men privately hoped for the nomination, but neither's name was formally submitted before the voters or the convention as a candidate.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1920年3月9日至6月5日，民主党选民选出代表，参加民主党全国代表大会并提名1920年美国总统选举候选人。竞选期间局势充满不确定性：该党最受关注的两位人选——总统伍德罗·威尔逊和三度参选的威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩——都没有公开表态。两人私下都希望获得提名，但在初选或党代会上都没有正式登记为候选人。

en.s: The Merthyr by-election, 1934 was a parliamentary by-election held on 5 June 1934 for the British House of Commons constituency of Merthyr in Wales. The seat had become vacant when the Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Richard Wallhead had died on 27 April 1934, aged 64. He had won the seat at the 1922 general election as a Labour candidate. At the 1931 general election, he had been returned as an Independent Labour Party (ILP) candidate, but had rejoined the Labour Party in 1933. The Labour candidate, Stephen Owen Davies, held the seat for his party.

zh.s: 英国下议院威尔士梅瑟蒂德选区于1934年6月5日举行议会补选。工党议员理查德·沃尔黑德于1934年4月27日去世，享年64岁，该席位因此空缺。他曾在1922年大选中作为工党候选人赢得该席位；1931年大选时则代表独立工党当选，并于1933年重返工党。工党候选人斯蒂芬·欧文·戴维斯为该党保住了席位。

en.t: Brazil v Poland (1938 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: Brazil 6–5 Poland was a football match held during the 1938 FIFA World Cup in France and still remembered by many Polish fans as Poland's first ever FIFA World Cup match. It is also Brazil's highest-scoring match in a FIFA World Cup tournament. The match held the record for the highest-scoring World Cup match until 1954, when Austria beat Switzerland 7–5.

zh.s: 巴西对波兰之战是1938年在法国举行的世界杯足球赛中的一场比赛，至今仍令许多波兰球迷难忘，因为这是波兰首次参加世界杯。它也是巴西在世界杯赛场上进球最多的一场比赛。这场比赛保持着世界杯单场进球数最多的纪录，直到1954年奥地利以7比5击败瑞士。

en.t: Civilians die in the Chongqing tunnel disaster during a Japanese air raid
en.s: On June 5, 1941, Japanese aircraft raided Chongqing for more than five hours. Crowds sheltering in the city’s air-raid tunnels became trapped amid poor ventilation and crushes. Many died from suffocation or trampling; historical reports give different death tolls.
en.n: Chongqing Municipal Archives confirms the date; estimates of the death toll differ.

zh.t: 日军空袭重庆期间发生大隧道惨案
zh.s: 1941年6月5日，日军对重庆持续空袭五个多小时。大量市民涌入防空隧道避难，因过度拥挤、通风不足，许多人窒息或在踩踏中遇难。不同史料对死亡人数的统计并不一致。
zh.n: 重庆市档案馆证实事件发生于6月5日；遇难人数的估计存在差异。

en.s: The Allied Control Council (ACC) or Allied Control Authority (German: Alliierter Kontrollrat), also referred to as the Four Powers (Vier Mächte), was the governing body of the Allied occupation zones in Germany (1945–1949/1991) and Austria (1945–1955) following the end of World War II in Europe. en.t: The British Secretary of State for War, John Profumo, resigns in a sex scandal known as the "Profumo affair"
en.s: John Dennis Profumo ( prə-FEW-moh; 30 January 1915 – 9 March 2006) was a British politician whose career ended in 1963 after a sexual relationship with the 19-year-old model Christine Keeler in 1961. The scandal, which became known as the Profumo affair, led to his resignation from the Conservative government of Harold Macmillan. After his resignation Profumo worked as a volunteer at Toynbee Hall, a charity in East London, and became its chief fundraiser.

zh.t: 约翰·普罗富莫辞职（普罗富莫事件）
zh.s: 英国战争大臣约翰·普罗富莫因性丑闻辞职，这起丑闻被称为“普罗富莫事件”。约翰·丹尼斯·普罗富莫（1915年1月30日—2006年3月9日）是英国政治人物。1961年，他与19岁的模特克里斯汀·基勒发生关系，政治生涯于1963年因此结束。这起丑闻导致他辞去哈罗德·麦克米伦保守党政府的职务。辞职后，他在东伦敦慈善机构托因比馆担任志愿者，后来成为该机构的主要筹款人。

en.s: The 1966 Quebec general election was held on June 5, 1966, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Quebec, Canada. The Union Nationale (UN), led by Daniel Johnson, Sr, defeated the incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Jean Lesage. In terms of the number of seats won, the election was one of the closest in recent history, with the UN winning 56 seats to the Liberals' 50.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省于1966年6月5日举行大选，选举魁北克立法议会议员。丹尼尔·约翰逊领导的民族联盟党击败由让·勒萨日领导的魁北克自由党。在席位数上，这是近代以来竞争最激烈的选举之一：民族联盟党赢得56席，自由党赢得50席。

en.s: Operation Crazy Horse (16 May to 5 June 1966), named after Lakota warrior Crazy Horse, was a search and destroy mission during the Vietnam War conducted by military forces of the United States, South Vietnam, and South Korea in two valleys in Bình Định Province of South Vietnam.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 疯狂马行动于1966年5月16日至6月5日进行，是越南战争期间的一次搜索与摧毁任务。行动以拉科塔族战士疯狂马命名，由美国、南越和韩国军队在南越平定省的两个山谷执行。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Six-Day War, or the 1967 Arab–Israeli war (5–10 June 1967), was fought between Israel and a coalition of Arab states, primarily Egypt, Syria, and Jordan, in the context of the Arab–Israeli conflict. In the war, Israel captured and occupied the West Bank (including East Jerusalem) from Jordan, the Gaza Strip and the Sinai Peninsula from Egypt, and the Golan Heights from Syria.

zh.s: 六日战争又称1967年阿以战争，于1967年6月5日至10日爆发。以色列与阿拉伯国家组成的联盟交战，主要对手是埃及、叙利亚和约旦。战争期间，以色列从约旦手中夺取并占领约旦河西岸（包括东耶路撒冷），从埃及手中夺取加沙地带和西奈半岛，并从叙利亚手中夺取戈兰高地。

en.s: Operation Union II was a search and destroy mission in the Quế Sơn Valley carried out by the 5th Marine Regiment. Launched on 26 May 1967 the operation ended on 5 June. U.S. reported the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) lost 701 killed and 23 captured, while U.S. casualties were 110 killed and 241 wounded.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 联合行动二号是由美国海军陆战队第5团在桂山谷执行的一次搜索与摧毁行动，1967年5月26日开始，6月5日结束。美方报告称，越南人民军有701人阵亡、23人被俘；美军有110人阵亡、241人受伤。

en.s: The assassination of Robert Francis "Bobby" Kennedy, a United States Senator and brother of assassinated President John Fitzgerald "Jack" Kennedy, took place shortly after midnight on June 5, 1968, in Los Angeles, California, during the campaign season for the 1968 presidential election. After winning the California and South Dakota primary elections for the Democratic nomination for President of the United States, Kennedy was fatally shot as he walked through the kitchen of the Ambassador Hotel and died in the Good Samaritan Hospital twenty-six hours later. Sirhan Sirhan, a 24-year-old Palestinian/Jordanian immigrant, was convicted of Kennedy's murder and is serving a life sentence for the crime.

zh.s: 美国参议员罗伯特·弗朗西斯·“鲍比”·肯尼迪是遭刺杀的总统约翰·菲茨杰拉德·“杰克”·肯尼迪的弟弟。1968年6月5日午夜过后，他在美国总统竞选期间于加利福尼亚州洛杉矶遇刺。当时他刚赢得加利福尼亚州和南达科他州民主党总统候选人初选。肯尼迪经过大使酒店厨房时遭枪击，伤重不治，约26小时后在仁慈医院去世。24岁的巴勒斯坦裔约旦移民瑟汉·瑟汉因杀害肯尼迪被判有罪，正在服无期徒刑。

en.t: United Kingdom European Communities membership referendum, 1975
en.s: (See also: United Kingdom European Union membership referendum, 2016) The United Kingdom EC referendum of 1975, also known as the Common Market referendum and EEC membership referendum was a referendum held on 5 June 1975 in the United Kingdom to gauge support for the country's continued membership of the European Communities (EC), often known as the Common Market at the time, which it had entered in 1973 under the Conservative government of Edward Heath. Labour's manifesto for the October 1974 general election promised that the people would decide "through the ballot box" whether to remain in the EEC.

zh.t: 1975年英国欧洲共同体成员资格公投
zh.s: 1975年英国欧洲共同体公投也称共同市场公投或欧洲经济共同体成员资格公投，于1975年6月5日在英国举行，决定该国是否继续留在欧洲共同体（当时通常称为“共同市场”）。英国于1973年在爱德华·希思领导的保守党政府任内加入欧洲共同体。工党在1974年10月大选纲领中承诺，让民众“通过投票箱”决定是否留在欧洲经济共同体。

en.t: The Teton Dam in Idaho, United States, collapses. Eleven people are killed as a result of flooding
en.s: The Teton Dam was an earthen dam in the western United States, on the Teton River in eastern Idaho. It was built by the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, one of eight federal agencies authorized to construct dams. Located between Fremont and Madison counties, it suffered a catastrophic failure on June 5, 1976, as it was filling for the first time.

zh.t: 美国爱达荷州提顿大坝溃决，洪水造成11人死亡
zh.s: 美国爱达荷州的提顿大坝于1976年6月5日溃决。该坝是位于美国西部爱达荷州东部提顿河上的土坝，由美国垦务局修建。该局是获准建坝的8个联邦机构之一。大坝位于弗里蒙特县和麦迪逊县之间，首次蓄水时发生灾难性溃决。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 5 June 1977, on the same day as for the senate. Elections took place in the middle of a political race between the right-wing Justice Party (AP) and the left-wing Republican People's Party (CHP). With the charismatic leadership of Bülent Ecevit, the CHP managed to beat one of the symbolic figures of conservative politics in Turkey, Süleyman Demirel.

zh.s: 土耳其于1977年6月5日举行大选，同日还举行参议院选举。选举正值右翼正义党与左翼共和人民党激烈竞争之时。在比伦特·埃杰维特富有号召力的领导下，共和人民党击败了土耳其保守派政治的代表人物之一苏莱曼·德米雷尔。

en.s: The 1977 Seychelles coup d'état was a coup that occurred in the East African and Indian Ocean country of Seychelles on 4–5 June 1977. Between 60–200 supporters of the Seychelles People's United Party (SPUP), who had been training in Tanzania, overthrew President Sir James Mancham of the Seychelles Democratic Party (SDP) while he was attending the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting in London, the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 1977年6月4日至5日，东非及印度洋岛国塞舌尔发生政变。60至200名塞舌尔人民联合党支持者曾在坦桑尼亚接受训练。他们趁塞舌尔民主党籍总统詹姆斯·曼卡姆爵士在英国伦敦参加英联邦政府首脑会议时，推翻了他。

en.s: The Second Sudanese Civil War was a conflict from 1983 to 2005 between the central Sudanese government and the Sudan People's Liberation Army. It was largely a continuation of the First Sudanese Civil War of 1955 to 1972. Although it originated in southern Sudan, the civil war spread to the Nuba Mountains and the Blue Nile. It lasted for almost 22 years and is one of the longest civil wars on record.

zh.s: 第二次苏丹内战从1983年持续到2005年，交战双方是苏丹中央政府与苏丹人民解放军。它在很大程度上延续了1955年至1972年的第一次苏丹内战。战火起于苏丹南部，后来蔓延至努巴山地和青尼罗河地区，历时近22年，是有记录以来持续时间最长的内战之一。

en.s: The 1984 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary was held on June 5, 1984, in New Jersey as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1984 United States presidential election. Former vice president Walter Mondale won an overwhelming victory over U.S. senator Gary Hart and civil rights activist Jesse Jackson, winning 45 percent of the vote but sweeping nearly all of the state's 107 pledged delegates.

zh.t: 1984年新泽西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 新泽西州于1984年6月5日举行民主党总统初选，是民主党在1984年美国总统选举前举行的州级提名竞选之一。前副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔以压倒性优势击败联邦参议员加里·哈特和民权活动家杰西·杰克逊，赢得45%的选票，并拿下该州107名承诺代表中的几乎全部。

en.s: The 1990 Cup of the Soviet Army final was the 8th and last final of the Cup of the Soviet Army (as a secondary cup tournament in Bulgaria), and was contested between CSKA Sofia and Botev Plovdiv on 5 June 1990 at Ovcha Kupel Stadium in Sofia. CSKA won the final 2–1.

zh.s: 1990年苏联陆军杯决赛是保加利亚次级杯赛苏联陆军杯的第8届、也是最后一届决赛。索非亚中央陆军队与普罗夫迪夫博特夫队于1990年6月5日在索非亚的奥夫查库佩尔球场交手，中央陆军队以2比1获胜。

en.s: The 1990 San Jose mayoral election was held to elect the mayor of San Jose, California. It saw an initial election held on June 5, 1990, followed by a runoff election on November 3, 1990, after no candidate managed to obtain a majority in the initial election. The runoff was won by Susan Hammer. Incumbent mayor Tom McEnery was term limited.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州圣何塞市于1990年6月5日举行市长选举，之后于11月3日举行决选，因为首轮无人获得过半数选票。苏珊·哈默赢得决选。时任市长汤姆·麦克埃纳里因任期限制不能再次参选。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Guatemala on 5 June 1993. They were sparked by the 1993 Guatemalan constitutional crisis in which President Jorge Serrano Elías had attempted a self-coup. The result was a victory for Ramiro de León Carpio, who won unopposed in the second round of voting, whilst the army-backed Arturo Herbruger was elected vice-president.

zh.s: 危地马拉于1993年6月5日举行间接总统选举。选举缘于1993年危地马拉宪政危机：时任总统豪尔赫·塞拉诺·埃利亚斯曾试图发动自我政变。拉米罗·德莱昂·卡皮奥在第二轮投票中无人竞选，最终当选总统；军方支持的阿图罗·埃尔布鲁格则当选副总统。

en.t: Republic of the Congo Civil War (1997–1999)
en.s: The Second Republic of the Congo Civil War, also known as the Second Brazzaville-Congolese Civil War, was the second of two ethnopolitical civil conflicts in the Republic of the Congo which lasted from 5 June 1997 to 29 December 1999. The war served as the continuation of the civil war of 1993–1994 and involved militias representing three political candidates.

zh.t: 刚果共和国第二次内战（1997—1999年）
zh.s: 刚果共和国第二次内战又称第二次布拉柴维尔—刚果内战，是该国两场族群政治冲突中的第二场，持续时间为1997年6月5日至1999年12月29日。这场战争延续了1993—1994年的内战，涉及代表三名政治候选人的民兵组织。

en.s: On 5 June 2000, a coup d'état occurred in Solomon Islands, in the capital of Honiara, in which the prime minister, Bartholomew Ulufa'alu, was taken hostage by militants of the Malaita Eagle Force. The event came as a result of longstanding ethnic tensions between the province that saw a rise in armed political groups from the late 1990s.

zh.s: 2000年6月5日，所罗门群岛首都霍尼亚拉发生政变。马莱塔鹰军武装分子扣押了总理巴塞洛缪·乌卢法阿卢。事件起因是长期存在的族群紧张局势；自20世纪90年代末起，相关省份出现了越来越多的武装政治团体。

en.s: The Six-Day War (French: Guerre des Six Jours) was a series of armed confrontations between Ugandan and Rwandan forces around the city of Kisangani in the Democratic Republic of the Congo from 5 to 10 June 2000. The war formed part of the wider Second Congo War (1998–2003). Kisangani was also a scene of violence between Rwandan and Ugandan troops in August 1999 and 5 May 2000.

zh.s: 2000年6月5日至10日，乌干达和卢旺达军队在刚果民主共和国基桑加尼市周边发生一系列武装冲突，史称六日战争（法语：Guerre des Six Jours）。这场战争是第二次刚果战争（1998—2003年）的一部分。1999年8月和2000年5月5日，基桑加尼也曾发生卢旺达和乌干达军队之间的暴力冲突。

en.s: A special general election was held on June 5, 2001, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives from California's 32nd congressional district to replace Julian Dixon, who died on December 8, 2000, of a heart attack. A special blanket primary was held on April 10, 2001, of which Democratic Ambassador Diane Watson won nearly a third of the vote in a field of sixteen candidates.

zh.t: 2001年加利福尼亚州第32国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2001年6月5日举行特别大选，选出美国众议院加州第32国会选区议员，接替于2000年12月8日因心脏病去世的朱利安·迪克森。4月10日举行的特别全体候选人初选（blanket primary）共有16名候选人，民主党籍大使黛安·沃森获得近三分之一的选票。

en.s: The Battle of Matejče (Macedonian: Битката кај Матејче Albanian: Beteja e Mateçit) was a military confrontation between the National Liberation Army (NLA) and the Macedonian Army in the village of Matejče during the 2001 insurgency in Macedonia. The NLA succeeded in capturing the village on 5 June 2001 and the Macedonian Army was forced to withdraw from Matejče. The Macedonian Army continued to shell Matejče until 11 June 2001.

zh.s: 马泰切战役是2001年马其顿叛乱期间，民族解放军与马其顿军队在马泰切村发生的一次军事冲突。2001年6月5日，民族解放军攻占该村，马其顿军队被迫撤离。马其顿军队继续炮击马泰切，直到6月11日。

en.s: Ethnic Albanian militants of the National Liberation Army killed five soldiers of the Army of the Republic of Macedonia on 5 June 2001 near Gajre, a village in the Šar Mountains, North Macedonia. It represents one of the heaviest death tolls for the government forces in a single incident during the insurgency in the Republic of Macedonia.

zh.s: 2001年6月5日，民族解放军的阿尔巴尼亚族武装分子在北马其顿沙尔山脉附近的盖雷村，打死5名马其顿共和国军士兵。这是马其顿共和国叛乱期间，政府军单次事件中伤亡最惨重的事件之一。

en.s: The 2001 Los Angeles mayoral election was for a four-year term as mayor of Los Angeles, California. It took place on April 10, 2001, with a runoff on June 5, 2001. Incumbent mayor Richard Riordan was prevented from running for a third term because of term limits. In the election to replace him, then-City Attorney James Hahn defeated Antonio Villaraigosa, the former speaker of the California State Assembly.

en.t: Glenn Cunningham wins the Jersey City mayoral runoff
en.s: On June 5, 2001, Glenn Cunningham defeated Thomas A. DeGise in Jersey City’s mayoral runoff, becoming the first African American elected mayor of the city. The nonpartisan election’s first round had taken place on May 8. Incumbent mayor Bret Schundler did not seek re-election.

zh.t: 格伦·坎宁安赢得泽西市市长决选
zh.s: 2001年6月5日，格伦·坎宁安在泽西市市长决选中击败托马斯·A.德吉斯，成为该市首位当选市长的非裔美国人。这场无党派选举的首轮投票已于5月8日举行。现任市长布雷特·申德勒没有寻求连任。

en.s: STS-111 was a space shuttle mission to the International Space Station (ISS) flown by Space Shuttle Endeavour. STS-111 resupplied the station and replaced the Expedition 4 crew with the Expedition 5 crew. It was launched on 5 June 2002, from Kennedy Space Center, Florida.

zh.s: STS-111是奋进号航天飞机执行的一次国际空间站任务，为空间站补给，并用远征5乘组替换远征4乘组。该航天飞机于2002年6月5日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心发射升空。

en.s: Expedition 5 was the fifth long-duration stay on the International Space Station (ISS). The crew, consisting of three people, remained in space for 184 days, 178 of which were spent aboard the ISS. Expedition 5 was a continuation of an uninterrupted human presence in space, as of November 2000, which was begun by Expedition 1 in 2000–2001. The crew of Expedition 5 launched to space aboard the Space Shuttle Endeavour aboard the STS-111 mission on 5 June 2002.

zh.s: 远征5是国际空间站的第五次长期驻留任务。三名乘组成员在太空停留184天，其中178天在国际空间站上度过。自2000年11月起，人类在太空持续驻留；这一连续驻留始于2000—2001年的远征1。远征5乘组于2002年6月5日搭乘奋进号航天飞机执行STS-111任务升空。

en.s: The 2002 Fine Gael leadership election began in May 2002, when Michael Noonan resigned as party leader due to the party's poor performance in the 2002 general election. Noonan had only been party leader for little over fifteen months. His successor was elected by the members of the Fine Gael parliamentary party on 5 June 2002. After one ballot the election was won by Enda Kenny.

zh.s: 统一爱尔兰党党魁选举于2002年5月启动。当年大选中该党表现不佳，迈克尔·努南因此辞去党魁职务；他担任党魁的时间略多于15个月。该党议会党团成员于2002年6月5日选出继任者。选举只进行一轮，由恩达·肯尼胜出。

en.s: The 2002 Cupa României final was the 64th final of Romania's most prestigious cup competition. The final was played at the Stadionul Național in Bucharest on 5 June 2002 and was contested between Divizia A sides Rapid București and Dinamo București. The cup was won by Rapid.

zh.s: 2002年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最重要杯赛的第64届决赛，于2002年6月5日在布加勒斯特国家体育场举行。参赛双方是甲级联赛球队布加勒斯特快速队和布加勒斯特迪纳摩队，快速队夺冠。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Dublin South constituency in Ireland on Friday, 5 June 2009, following the death of the Fianna Fáil Teachta Dála (TD) Séamus Brennan on 9 July 2008. en.s: The blaze started at 3pm (2200 GMT) on Friday, June 5, 2009. It was initially reported that the fire began in a tire warehouse next door and then spread to the child care center. Further investigation revealed that the actual source was a different warehouse, one operated by the state government. Within just a few minutes the fire caused the collapse of a roof section which fell on the children, infants and employees below. One of the first responders on the scene reported that all children were unconscious or dead and there were no sounds of children crying.

en.s: Recall elections for four Wisconsin state senators were held during the spring of 2012. Voters put four state senators up for recall, all Republicans, because of the budget repair bill proposed by Governor Scott Walker and circumstances surrounding it. Democrats targeted Republicans for voting to significantly limit public employee collective bargaining. Scholars could cite only four times in American history when more than one state legislator has been recalled at roughly the same time over the same issue. The recall elections occurred on June 5, with May 8 being the date of the primary election.

zh.t: 2012年威斯康星州参议员罢免选举
zh.s: 2012年春季，威斯康星州四名州参议员面临罢免选举，四人均为共和党人。罢免行动源于州长斯科特·沃克提出的预算修复法案及相关争议。民主党人针对投票支持大幅限制公职人员集体谈判权的共和党人发起罢免。学者指出，美国历史上仅有四次出现多名州议员因同一议题而在大致同一时期遭罢免的情况。罢免选举于6月5日举行，初选日期为5月8日。

en.s: On June 5, 2012, California held its Republican presidential primary. Mitt Romney won 1,530,513 votes, or 79.5%, ahead of Ron Paul with 199,246 votes, or 10.4%. Romney won the 169 delegates bound by the primary result; three additional party leaders attended the national convention as unpledged delegates.

zh.s: 2012年6月5日，加利福尼亚州举行共和党总统初选。米特·罗姆尼获得1,530,513票，占79.5%；罗恩·保罗以199,246票、10.4%的得票率位居第二。罗姆尼赢得了由初选结果决定的169名全国代表大会代表；另有3名党内领导人以不受初选结果约束的代表身份参会。

en.s: The 2012 Wisconsin lieutenant gubernatorial recall election was held on June 5, 2012 to decide whether to retain or recall the lieutenant governor of Wisconsin. Voters decided to retain incumbent Republican lieutenant governor Rebecca Kleefisch over recalling her in favor of the Democratic candidate Mahlon Mitchell. Kleefisch's retention made her the first lieutenant governor in U.S. history to run in and survive a recall.

en.s: The 2012 transit of Venus, when the planet Venus appeared as a small, dark spot passing across the face of the Sun, began at 22:09 UTC on 5 June 2012, and finished at 04:49 UTC on 6 June. Depending on the position of the observer, the exact times varied by up to ±7 minutes. Transits of Venus are among the rarest of predictable celestial phenomena and occur in pairs.

In her two terms as United States Senator from New York, the state with the largest population of Puerto Rican-Americans, she gained a strong degree of familiarity with the island.

zh.s: 波多黎各于2016年6月5日举行民主党总统初选，是民主党在2016年总统选举前举行的初选之一。希拉里·克林顿被普遍看好，预计将大幅赢得该地区初选。她曾担任纽约州联邦参议员两届；纽约州的波多黎各裔人口最多，因此她对该岛较为熟悉。

en.s: The 2016 Aktobe shootings were a series of shootings on civilian and military targets in Aktobe, Kazakhstan, in June 2016. On 5 June, two attacks occurred at gun stores, while a third attack was aimed at a military unit. Multiple shootouts between terrorists and police occurred over the next few days. The shootings left 7 victims dead and 37 injured,Other 6 injured died at hospital and its 13 dead in total.

en.t: 2018 Orange County, California District Attorney election
en.s: The 2018 Orange, County, California District Attorney election took place on June 5, 2018, for the first round. Because no candidate received a majority in the first round, a runoff took place November 6, 2018, to elect the Orange County, California District Attorney. County-level elections in California are officially nonpartisan. Because no candidate received a majority, a runoff was held on November 6, 2018.

en.t: 2018 Orange County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2018 Orange County Board of Supervisors elections were held on June 5, 2018, and November 6, 2018. Three of the five seats of the Orange County, California Board of Supervisors were up for election. County elections in California are officially nonpartisan. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with the first round in June, followed by a runoff in November between the top two candidates in each district.

en.t: 2018 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2018 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election was held on June 5 and November 6, 2018, to elect the Superintendent of Public Instruction of California. Unlike most other elections in California, the superintendent is not elected under the state's "top-two primary". Instead, the officially nonpartisan position is elected at a primary election, with a runoff at a general election if no candidate receives a majority of the vote.

en.t: 2020 Saint Kitts and Nevis general election
en.s: General elections were held in Saint Kitts and Nevis on Friday 5 June 2020. The ruling Team Unity coalition consisting of the People's Action Movement, Concerned Citizens' Movement and People's Labour Party won a landslide victory with nine of the eleven directly elected seats with a combined 55% of the vote. As had happened in the previous elections in 2015, the Saint Kitts and Nevis Labour Party received the most votes but did not win the most seats.

zh.s: 圣基茨和尼维斯于2020年6月5日（星期五）举行大选。执政的团结队联盟由人民行动运动、关切公民运动和人民工党组成，赢得11个直选席位中的9席，合计得票率为55%，大获全胜。与2015年上次选举一样，圣基茨和尼维斯工党得票最多，却没有赢得最多席位。

en.s: Communal elections were held in Cambodia on 5 June 2022. The election precedes the 2023 general election and the 2024 Senate election. 9.2 million of 10.5 million eligible voters were registered to cast their ballots.
